import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.weights.weights import WeightData, WeightLambda


def _toy_reweight(params, metadata, events, size, shape_variation):
    original = events.LHEWeight_originalXWGTUP
    nominal = original / ak.mean(original)
    return WeightData(
        name="toy_reweight",
        nominal=nominal,
        up=nominal * 1.05,
        down=nominal * 0.95,
    )


toy_reweight = WeightLambda.wrap_func(
    name="toy_reweight",
    function=_toy_reweight,
    has_variations=True,
)
